title: antiphytum stoechadifolium
intro: Antiphytum stoechadifolium, commonly known as Stoechas or False Rosemary, is a small shrub-like plant native to the Mediterranean region. It is valued for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Antiphytum stoechadifolium include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory problems. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
